task: Ground factual claims for the Workspace Monitor history timeline and folder structure map extension.
output_summary: The existing workspace-monitor project was extended so repository history files are collected into date-indexed snapshot data, displayed with date and type filters, and paired with a folder structure map derived from workspace governance files.

evidence.reliability: Repository-maintained Korean summary of the user's request to collect history, show dates on the web, and reconsider folder structure.
Tracked web-first search record with checked sources and plan impact.
Official Next.js documentation for static export behavior.
Official React documentation for rendering arrays of data.
Official React documentation for conditional UI rendering.
Tracked collector script that creates document, history, and folder structure snapshot data.
Tracked TypeScript snapshot model used by the UI.
Tracked dashboard component implementing History and Structure views.
Tracked collector tests covering history date extraction and folder structure snapshot generation.
Tracked close-out validation plan and command results for the feature.

claims.statement: Workspace Monitor now emits date-indexed history data through the `historyDays` snapshot field.
verification_steps: Ran `npm run collect` and the collector test suite.
Checked the generated snapshot smoke output for a nonzero `historyDays` count.

claims.statement: Workspace Monitor now emits folder structure data through the `folderStructure` snapshot field.
verification_steps: Ran `npm run collect` and the collector test suite.
Checked the generated snapshot smoke output for root folders, docs categories, project homes, and history roots.

claims.statement: The dashboard UI has a History view with date and category filters plus a Structure view for root folders, docs categories, project homes, and history source roots.
verification_steps: Ran `npm run build` and a static output smoke check for History and Structure labels.

claims.statement: Keeping the feature in the existing static snapshot architecture is compatible with Next.js static export guidance.
verification_steps: Checked the official Next.js static export guide on 2026-06-01.
Ran `npm run build` for the existing static export project.

claims.statement: The UI uses standard React list and conditional rendering patterns for the timeline, filters, and empty states.
verification_steps: Checked official React list and conditional rendering documentation on 2026-06-01.
Inspected the implemented `filteredHistoryDays` and section rendering logic.

uncertainty_notes: The generated public snapshot intentionally mirrors repository documentation excerpts; it must be reviewed before a public deployment.
History files without a date in their path or title are kept in the general document index but are not represented as dated timeline groups.
limitation_notes: The in-app Browser tool was not exposed in this session, so rendered UI verification was performed through build and static HTML smoke checks instead of screenshots.
No live Vercel deployment was created in this change set.
